title: Language Glossary
description: Per-language glossary for manual translation. Contains localized key names and term translations with notes.

nativeName.description: Language name in the language itself (e.g. "Русский", "Deutsch", "עברית")

keys.description: Mapping of standard key names to their localized equivalents. Keys are the canonical English name, values are the localized name. Only include keys that differ from English; unlisted keys keep their English name.

terms.description: Glossary entries for consistent translation of product-specific and technical terms.

term.description: The term in American English as it appears in the English manual

translation.description: The exact translation to use in this language. Must include proper diacritics, never ASCII approximations.

context.description: Where this term appears or what it refers to, to disambiguate (e.g. "menu item" vs "general concept")

notes.description: Why this specific translation was chosen, alternatives rejected, or usage constraints
